title: Audio probe
description: Read-only report on how the head unit's sound is built (ALSA cards and running streams, sound servers, who holds the devices), to see whether the music's level can be read. Nothing is captured, played or changed. The report goes to a USB stick when one is in, and to /var/opt/mgu-audio-probe/reports. Play music while it runs: after the install and 3 minutes after each start.
